name: mcp-azahar

tools.name: azahar_attach
tools.description: Register an Azahar started by hand (RPC server enabled, app loaded) as a session.

session.description: session name (default: the server's default session)

tools.name: azahar_circle_pad
tools.description: Move the circle pad to x, y in -154..154 each (0, 0 is centered; x right, y up): for for_ms (default 100 ms) or held until azahar_release.

session.description: session name (default: the server's default session)

x.description: x coordinate (range in the tool description)

y.description: y coordinate (range in the tool description)

tools.name: azahar_hold
tools.description: Hold buttons until azahar_release; press, touch and circle pad apply on top. Buttons: A B X Y L R ZL ZR START SELECT UP DOWN LEFT RIGHT HOME POWER (case-insensitive).

session.description: session name (default: the server's default session)

tools.name: azahar_launch
tools.description: Start Azahar headless with an app in a new session and wait until its RPC server answers (up to 2 minutes). Fails if the session exists or another emulator holds the RPC port. Linux/macOS only. The emulator keeps running until azahar_stop.

session.description: session name (default: the server's default session)

app.description: path of the homebrew to boot (.3dsx .cci .3ds .cxi .app .elf)

elf.description: matching ELF with symbols, for azahar_read_symbol, azahar_wait_for and azahar_symbols

display.description: existing X display (e.g. :0) instead of a private Xvfb

tools.name: azahar_load_state
tools.description: Load the state in slot 0-10 (it must exist). Held input is applied again afterwards.

session.description: session name (default: the server's default session)

tools.name: azahar_logs
tools.description: Return the last matching lines of Azahar's log (complete lines only) and the byte offset to pass as from next time, to get only lines written since.

session.description: session name (default: the server's default session)

tail.description: only the last N matching lines (default 200, at most 1000)

from.description: byte offset to start at: the offset of a previous call, to get only newer lines

tools.name: azahar_press
tools.description: Press buttons for for_ms (default 100 ms), then return to the held input. Buttons: A B X Y L R ZL ZR START SELECT UP DOWN LEFT RIGHT HOME POWER (case-insensitive).

session.description: session name (default: the server's default session)

for_ms.description: how long to press in milliseconds (default 100)

tools.name: azahar_read_memory
tools.description: Read bytes of the app's memory; returns them as hex. Prefer azahar_read_symbol when the app's ELF is known.

session.description: session name (default: the server's default session)

length.description: number of bytes, at most 4096 (unmapped memory reads as zeros)

tools.name: azahar_read_symbol
tools.description: Read a variable (or address) and decode it by its C type: numbers, bools, enums by name, plain char arrays as text, structs and arrays as JSON. Values over 16 KiB are refused: read a field or element. target is a variable of the app's ELF: a name, then .field and [index] parts ("test_state.touch.x", "table[2]"); C++ "ns::name", static locals "func::name", a static sharing its name "file.c:name". Or an address (hex 0x... or decimal) with type (default u32). Types: u8 u16 u32 u64 s8 s16 s32 s64 f32 f64 bool string bytes (string/bytes need len for addresses).

session.description: session name (default: the server's default session)

type.description: decode as this type instead of the DWARF type

elf.description: ELF file instead of the session's

tools.name: azahar_release
tools.description: Release held buttons, the held touch or circle pad; with nothing named, everything. Buttons: A B X Y L R ZL ZR START SELECT UP DOWN LEFT RIGHT HOME POWER (case-insensitive).

session.description: session name (default: the server's default session)

buttons.description: buttons to release; with nothing named everything is released

tools.name: azahar_save_state
tools.description: Save the emulator state to slot 0-10 (overwrites it). For launched sessions it waits until the file is written.

session.description: session name (default: the server's default session)

tools.name: azahar_screenshot
tools.description: Capture the next rendered frame of the top, bottom or both screens and return it as PNG image content. With output the PNG is also written to that file (overwritten).

session.description: session name (default: the server's default session)

screen.description: top (default, 400x240), bottom (320x240) or both (two consecutive frames, in 3DS arrangement)

scale.description: resolution scale 1-4 (default 1); 0 is Azahar's internal resolution

split.description: with screen both: one image per screen

output.description: also save the PNG to this file path

tools.name: azahar_sequence
tools.description:
Run a scripted test: steps, each with exactly one action and an optional name:
press (buttons, with for: 300ms), hold, release (buttons or "all"), touch {x, y, for|hold},
circle_pad {x, y, for|hold}, wait (duration), screenshot {screen, output, scale, split},
write {address, bytes}, assert {target, op, value, type, len}, wait_for {target, op, value,
timeout, interval}, save_state (slot), load_state (slot), log_contains {text, timeout}.
Durations like 100ms or 2s. The whole sequence is checked before the first step runs;
it stops at the first failure. log_contains only matches lines logged during the run.
File paths (elf, screenshot output) must be relative and stay inside the sequence's
directory. Example:
  steps:
    - press: A
    - wait_for: {target: test_state.frame, op: ge, value: 60, timeout: 5s}
    - assert: {target: test_state.last_buttons, value: 0}
    - screenshot: {screen: both, output: smoke.png}
The result has passed, and per step ok, error, error_kind (check or error) and duration_ms.

session.description: session name (default: the server's default session)

file.description: sequence file (YAML or JSON); its paths are relative to it

script.description: sequence as YAML or JSON text instead of file; its paths are relative to the server's first allowed directory

elf.description: ELF for symbol steps instead of the sequence's or session's

tools.name: azahar_sessions
tools.description: List sessions (stale ones are removed).

tools.name: azahar_status
tools.description: Show the session: whether the emulator runs and answers RPC, its processes, app, log file and held input. A session that is not running is reported, not an error.

session.description: session name (default: the server's default session)

tools.name: azahar_stop
tools.description: Stop the session's emulator (launched sessions) or forget it (attached sessions). Deletes the session directory unless keep_files.

session.description: session name (default: the server's default session)

keep_files.description: keep the session directory (logs, save states)

tools.name: azahar_symbols
tools.description: List variables and functions of the app's ELF (address, size, kind, C type), sorted by name; at most 500, use filter to narrow.

session.description: session name (default: the server's default session)

elf.description: ELF file instead of the session's

tools.name: azahar_touch
tools.description: Touch the bottom screen at x 0-319, y 0-239 (pixels, origin top left): for for_ms (default 100 ms) or held until azahar_release.

session.description: session name (default: the server's default session)

x.description: x coordinate (range in the tool description)

y.description: y coordinate (range in the tool description)

tools.name: azahar_wait_for
tools.description: Poll a variable (or address) until it compares true with value, or until timeout_ms (a check failure with the last value). Numbers compare numerically; bools, strings and enum names with eq/ne; changed waits for any change from the first read. target is a variable of the app's ELF: a name, then .field and [index] parts ("test_state.touch.x", "table[2]"); C++ "ns::name", static locals "func::name", a static sharing its name "file.c:name". Or an address (hex 0x... or decimal) with type (default u32). Types: u8 u16 u32 u64 s8 s16 s32 s64 f32 f64 bool string bytes (string/bytes need len for addresses).

session.description: session name (default: the server's default session)

type.description: decode as this type instead of the DWARF type

elf.description: ELF file instead of the session's

op.description: eq (default), ne, lt, le, gt, ge, or changed (no value)

value.description: literal: number (decimal or 0x), true/false, string or enum name

timeout_ms.description: how long to wait in milliseconds (default 10000)

tools.name: azahar_write_memory
tools.description: Write bytes to the app's memory and verify by reading back. Writes outside the app's image and heaps are ignored by Azahar and reported as an error.

session.description: session name (default: the server's default session)

bytes.description: hex bytes in memory order, e.g. "de ad be ef" (0x1234 means bytes 12 34)

instructions:
Drives the Azahar 3DS emulator to test homebrew: launch an app, send input,
take screenshots, read and write memory (by address or by variable name from
the app's ELF), wait for conditions, use save states, read the log and run
scripted test sequences.

Every tool acts on a session (optional "session" argument, default given by the
server). Start with azahar_status or azahar_sessions; if nothing runs, use
azahar_launch. Only one emulator with RPC can run per host. Sessions are shared
with the mcp-azahar CLI, and launched emulators keep running until
azahar_stop. Addresses are virtual addresses of the app process, as hex
("0x00101000") or decimal. Durations are in milliseconds. File paths (app,
elf, log, sequence file, screenshot output) must lie in the directories the
server allows (by default its working directory); relative paths are relative
to the first of them.
